description: AIHPC Advanced — Component Manifest (Bill of Materials). Lists all canvas-based interactive components with mount points, script paths, lazy-load status, and concept-card links. The audit script verifies every component in this manifest is loaded on its declared page and has a concept card (if applicable).

components.name: animated-derivation.js
components.description: Canvas-based Math→Code derivation animator with Play/Pause/Replay/Record-WebM/Share

components.name: graph-table-sync.js
components.description: Animated graph-table sync: data table rows appear on SVG graph one at a time, with inflection-point math annotations. Supports 2D + 3D (loss-landscape trajectory) modes.

components.name: nd-viewer.js
components.description: N-D hypercube viewer (4-10D) — projects N-D vertices to 3D via rotation chain. Lazy-loaded in modal.

components.name: bloch-sphere.js
components.description: 3D Bloch sphere with 9 scenes: ground, Hadamard, Rabi, phase S, measurement, decoherence, Bell |Φ+⟩, Bell singlet |Ψ-⟩, CHSH violation. Record-WebM.

components.name: ml-etl.js
components.description: CSV upload (y_true, y_pred) → live loss computation (MSE/MAE/log-cosh/Huber/KL/cosine) + push to GTS graphs.

components.name: molecule-3d.js
components.description: 3D ball-and-stick molecule viewer: SMILES→3D (Fibonacci sphere layout), CPK palette, pharmacophore overlay, 3D QSAR surface, N-D property strip.

components.name: medical-imaging.js
components.description: Multi-organ medical-imaging viewer: 6 peripheral slices (CT/MRI/X-ray/PET-CT/sagittal) with animated scanner sweep + 8 CPK-coloured organs + DICOM consumer.

components.name: vqc-animator.js
components.description: Variational quantum circuit animator: parameterised RZ gates + CNOT ring + parameter-shift training + barren-plateau variance chart. 2-8 qubits.

components.name: fock-state-viewer.js
components.description: Second-quantisation Fock state viewer: Hermite-polynomial wavefunctions + energy ladder + animated a/a† operators. 8 states. Record-WebM.

components.name: coupled-oscillator.js
components.description: Coupled quantum oscillators: 4-panel viewer (mode A/B energy levels + joint state matrix + correlation chart). Scenes: product, 2-mode squeezed, HOM, NOON.

components.name: quantum-circuit-canvas.js
components.description: Interactive quantum-circuit builder: drag-and-drop gates (H/X/Y/Z/S/T/CNOT) onto grid + real-time state vector + presets (Bell/GHZ/superposition/Grover) + measure.

components.name: attention-heatmap.js
components.description: Live attention heat-map: Q·K^T/√d_k weights as square heat-map with multi-head selector. Token-input box updates live.

components.name: segmentation-pipeline.js
components.description: Medical image segmentation pipeline: MRI→prediction mask→3D reconstruction + Dice/IoU/Hausdorff/sensitivity/specificity + tumour volume (cm³).

components.name: biomolecular-dynamics.js
components.description: BioEmu2-style 4-panel biomolecular dynamics: structure prediction + large complexes + equilibrium sampling + dynamics. Live pLDDT/ΔG/RMSD.

components.name: scientific-uploader.js
components.description: Multi-format scientific+big-data file uploader: PDB/SDF/CSV/Parquet/Arrow/HDF5/NPY/DICOM/FITS/VTK/JSON/HDFS with magic-bytes detection + consumer registration.
